texts.zh:
帝国倾向于增强我们新的合成身躯。通过提高人格转移的速度和规模，我们可以在危险任务中快速替换被摧毁的合成躯体。

这些新的形体允许我们对正电子脑进行拆解，以从最近去世的精英那里获得知识印记。作为帝国的仆人，这肯定是他们想要的。
texts.en:
The empire is favoring the enhancement of our new synthetic bodies.

These new forms allow for disassembly of the positronic brains to acquire knowledge imprints from our recently deceased elite. As servants of the empire, this is surely what they would have wanted.

texts.zh:
[From.GetSpeciesAdj]愿意更进一步，比起和物理世界藕断丝连，他们更倾向一个完全虚拟的存在。这一重大事件所产生的冲击将对我们的未来产生深远的影响。提速人格转移并扩大规模，我们就可以快速置换在危险任务中被摧毁的合成躯体。

这些全新的进展确乎可以提升我们在许多与战争有关的局面中的效率，为[From.GetSpeciesAdj]帝国带来荣光！
texts.en:
[From.GetSpeciesAdj] people are willing to go even further, and favor a fully virtual existence over the half-measures of the physical world. This momentous event will create shockwaves that echo far into our future. By boosting the identity transfer speed and range, we are able to deploy rapid replacements for destroyed synthetic bodies during hazardous missions.

These new developments are sure to increase our efficiency in various war-related situations, and bring glory to the [From.GetSpeciesAdj] empire!

texts.zh:
[From.GetSpeciesAdj]帝国走到了分岔路口。有人认为定制的身体会给我们带来安全感和熟悉感，而另一些人则反对充分利用合成化及其带来的一切。

专注于身躯方面让我们可以对短期内被毁的高官所具有的知识为科学加以利用。或者，通向虚拟存在的道路会使通过快速人格转移进行合成躯体的大规模置换成为可能。
texts.en:
The [From.GetSpeciesAdj] empire is at a crossroads. Some believe bespoke physical bodies would bring us security and familiarity, while others argue against taking full advantage of the synthesization and everything it can bring.

Focusing on the physical aspects would enable us to repurpose the knowledge of recently destroyed dignitaries for our research efforts. Alternatively, the path to virtual existence would allow mass-replacement of destroyed synthetic bodies via rapid identity transfer.

label.en: Utilize the minds of our departed leaders.

label.zh: 合成化不会让我们忘了自己是谁。
label.en: Synthesization does not change who we are.

summary.text:
# 合成化社会 / Synthesized Society

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：events/machine_age_situation_events_2.txt:2739-2832

## 如何开始 How it starts

- “合成冲击”事件链的终点：机会事件结束后180+随机90天，隐藏事件 synth.1500 按政体权威分发：民主 1505、寡头 1510、独裁 1515、帝制 1520、企业 1525。
  End of the "Synth Shock" chain: 180 days (+ random 90) after the opportunity event hidden synth.1500 switches on has_authority: democratic 1505, oligarchic 1510, dictatorial 1515, imperial 1520, corporate 1525.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 「帝制政体」的最终事件：国家选择实体化（synth_physical）或虚拟化（synth_virtual）的合成体取向并设置国家标志，虚拟化选项还会触发 cybernetics.5046；另有一个保留现状的选项。
  The final event for imperial governments: the country picks a physical (synth_physical) or virtual (synth_virtual) synthetic orientation and the matching country flag is set; the virtual option also fires cybernetics.5046; a third option keeps the status quo.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 故事终点；五个政体版本互斥（由 has_authority 决定）。
  The end of the chain; the five authority versions are exclusive (by has_authority).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 仅出现给帝制权威的国家。
  Shown only to imperial (authority auth_imperial) countries.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 说明：这十个最终事件（cyber/synth 1505–1525）不在任何审阅者的分配列表中，作为连带内容一并审阅。
  Note: these ten final events (cyber/synth 1505-1525) are in no reviewer's assignment list and were reviewed as part of the same chains.
- 已核对：触发条件、选项效果；编译树与脚本一致。
  Checked: trigger conditions and option effects; the compiled tree matches the script.
